_comment: new_card_injections.json — Override/seed card data for heroes not yet in fablazing_meta.db,
or to force new cards into existing hero decks before match data accumulates.
Each top-level key is a hero slug (fablazing format, e.g. 'dorinthea-ironsong').
'hero_name': Display name used in the deck file header.
'equipment': List of equipment/weapon cards to inject into the hero's arena.
'deck_cards': List of deck cards to inject into the hero's card pool.
card_name   (optional) — display name; looked up from slug_index if omitted
frequency   (optional) — simulated play rate 0.0–1.0; default 0.9 for forced inclusions
avg_copies  (optional) — average copies per deck; default 3.0 for deck cards, 1.0 for equipment
card_type   (optional) — 'deck' or 'equipment'; inferred from slug_index if omitted
Injections are merged with DB data BEFORE the legal-pool filter runs.
Real fablazing data (when it arrives) automatically wins because DB rows
are fetched first and injection rows are de-duplicated by card_slug.
